default_credentials.title: Default credentials active
default_credentials.remediation: Rotate credentials immediately and enforce unique per-device passwords stored in a vault.

modbus_no_auth.title: Modbus TCP (502) exposed without auth
modbus_no_auth.remediation: Restrict Modbus to the OT VLAN, apply a firewall allowlist for SCADA hosts only, and require VPN for remote access.

telnet_open.title: Telnet (23) open
telnet_open.remediation: Disable Telnet and use SSH with key-based authentication.

mqtt_anonymous.title: MQTT broker allows anonymous clients
mqtt_anonymous.remediation: Require client authentication (certificates or credentials) and enable TLS on the broker.

http_no_tls.title: Web management over HTTP (no TLS)
http_no_tls.remediation: Enable HTTPS with a valid certificate and disable the plain-HTTP management interface.

snmp_public.title: SNMP v1/v2 with 'public' community
snmp_public.remediation: Migrate to SNMPv3 with authentication and encryption; remove default community strings.

outdated_firmware.title: Outdated firmware
outdated_firmware.remediation: Schedule the vendor firmware update in the next maintenance window and verify the image signature.
